metadata.title: Parallel domains in $SL_3(\mathbb{R})$ and the ideal triangle reflection group
metadata.abstract: For a given positive triple of flags, we associate an open set, called a parallel domain, in the symmetric space of $SL_3 (\mathbb{R})$ whose boundary is parametrized by three spacelike geodesics of the pseudo-Riemannian symmetric space $SL_3 (\mathbb{R})/GL_2 (\mathbb{R})$. This construction is a higher-rank analog of how three points in the ideal boundary of the hyperbolic plane have an associated ideal triangle. As an application, using the fact that positive triples determine a representation of the ideal triangle reflection group into $SL_3(\mathbb{R})$, we show that these parallel domains are fundamental domains for the group action in the symmetric space. Moreover, using the explicit construction and combinatorial properties of the Farey tessellation, we compute the asymptotics for the critical exponent in the symmetric space and the Hilbert critical exponent as the triple ratio of the triple of flags goes to infinity.

analysis.progressType: SL₃对称空间的旗标平行域
analysis.workSummary: 给正旗标三元组在SL₃(R)对称空间中关联开平行域，边界由SL₃(R)/GL₂(R)中的三条类空测地线参数化。
analysis.breakthrough: 证明该域为相关理想三角反射群作用的基本域，并计算三比趋无穷时对称空间及Hilbert临界指数的渐近。
analysis.limitations: 域和表示依赖正性，临界指数的量纲、基点及三比规范需正文确认。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
